functions.purpose: Model init that registers the client->model command handler table for the Treasures/Entrust shop UI. Registers 7 named handlers: GetTreasuresBoxData, GetTreasuresShopData, GetEntrustMoney(->FUN_1095cc50), GetMedalTreasuresData, RequestGetAllTreasures, RequestTreasuresExchange, RequestGetMedalTreasures. Repeated FUN_100b62c0(makeString)/FUN_1095d720|FUN_1095d660(registerHandler)/FUN_10c3d5d0(freeString) triads — stock UI-binding plumbing.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only: builds the model's local command-dispatch table. Each 'Request*' entry is the client request that maps to a server RPC; the 'Get*' entries return locally-cached server data.
functions.notes: Handler thunks: RequestTreasuresExchange->FUN_1095cd20, RequestGetMedalTreasures->FUN_1095d530, GetEntrustMoney->FUN_1095cc50. LAB_1095d020 is one inline handler.

functions.purpose: GetEntrustMoney handler. Resolves the local player (DAT_1202e818+0xd0 -> +0x90 -> vtbl+0xb4 == GetLocalPlayer); if non-null, reads the two entrust-money balances via FUN_1025b060 and writes them into the outgoing VO as nEntrustMoney1Num and nEntrustMoney2Num (FUN_104d1550 = set-int field). local_1c>>6&1 tests bit 6 of a variant/AS-value header for the pointer-owned addref/release around the write.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only display of two server-authoritative entrust currency balances; server owns the actual balances.
formulas: nEntrustMoney1Num = FUN_1025b060(); nEntrustMoney2Num = FUN_1025b060()  // two successive money accessors
costs: nEntrustMoney1Num, nEntrustMoney2Num: two distinct entrust-currency balances shown in the entrust UI
functions.notes: in_stack_00000010 is the incoming request VO (variant array); fields [1]=header,[2..4] copied out.

functions.purpose: Model init registering the PvP-Battle / League-Entrust command handler table. Handlers: GetPvpBattleListData(->FUN_10985850), GetSelEntrustDetailData(->LevelEntrustDetailVO__BuildByGroup), GetLevelInstanceGoData(->FUN_10987380), GetHunterBoxData(->FUN_10986db0), GetAvalidActionPoint(->FUN_10986d30), AcceptPvpBattleTask(->FUN_10985650), SelHuntPacket(->FUN_10985790), PvpBattleReady(->FUN_109857e0), RequestPvpBattleList(->LAB_10985610), GiveUpPvpBattleTask(->FUN_109856b0), ReqOpenPvpBattleGoView(->FUN_10985700), ReqPvpBattleTrackData(->FUN_10987760), ReqOpenPvpBattleInfoByTrack(->FUN_10987b10).
functions.serverRelevance: client-only registration; the Accept/GiveUp/Ready/Request handlers are the client-side entry points that emit the corresponding server RPCs (server authoritatively accepts/gives-up/starts league tasks).
functions.notes: Same triad plumbing as FUN_1095c390. 'GetAvalidActionPoint' = action-point (stamina) accessor for the entrust task.

functions.purpose: GetPvpBattleListData handler (param_5==1 guard). Resolves local player, reads its league/pvp-battle data block (player+0x2b9c). Emits: maxPvpBattleCount, curPvpBattleCount, nEntrustVipCnt, plus three arrays: leagueTasksArr, pvpBattleListArr, pvpBattleNoticeArr. Iterates league entries (record stride 0x14=20 bytes) and notice entries (stride 0x18=24 bytes), building nested VOs (PVPBATTLE_LISTVO_CLASSNAME / PVPBATTLE_TASKVO_CLASSNAME / PVPBATTLE_NOTICEVO_CLASSNAME). Calls CLeagueInfo::CollectLeagueScheduleEntries for the schedule/notice list.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only display; all values (counts, vip count, league/task/notice lists, schedule times) originate from server-authoritative league state. maxPvpBattleCount / curPvpBattleCount are the server-tracked participation cap and current count.
formulas: maxPvpBattleCount = vtbl+0x20 accessor on player[0xae6]; curPvpBattleCount = vtbl+0x28 accessor on player[0xae6]
nEntrustVipCnt = FUN_11548ea0() only if player[0xabe] != 0, else 0
iCountLeague = (levelIdArrEnd - levelIdArrStart) >> 2   // count of 4-byte level IDs
league loop count = (EBX[2]-EBX[1]) / 0x14 ; per-entry: iLeagueID = *(base+4), levelIds span = *(base+0xc)-*(base+8)
costs: maxPvpBattleCount: per-period cap on PvP-battle/league task participation
curPvpBattleCount: current used count against the cap
functions.notes: Field strings: strTitleName, iLeagueID, iCountLeague, iLeagueName, levelGroupID, levelID, levelName, leagueTasksArr, pvpBattleListArr, noticeLeagueID, noticeStartLeagueTime, noticeEndLeagueTime, noticePvpBattleRound, noticeLeagueName, pvpBattleNoticeArr. Heavy Ghidra register-aliasing in body; loop strides are reliable, exact source offsets partly obscured.

functions.purpose: GetLevelInstanceGoData handler (in_stack_00000014==1 guard). Builds the teammemberInfoArr for the level-entrust 'go' view. Resolves local player and a party/team object (FUN_112ea0c0 returns [begin,end], iterating members at stride 0x2c=44 bytes). Per member emits fields via LEVELENTRUST_MEMBERVO_CLASSNAME: playerName (DAT_11dbac80), starLevel, level (DAT_11dccf88), weapon, class/job (DAT_11dd7eac), state=0, selHuntPacket=0xffffffff, bIsLeader=0. Also emits remainWarning (FUN_115768f0) at model level.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only display of party member info; membership, star levels and remainWarning are server-provided. state/selHuntPacket/bIsLeader are initialized to sentinel defaults client-side (state=0, selHuntPacket=-1/0xffffffff).
formulas: state initialized 0, selHuntPacket initialized 0xFFFFFFFF (no packet selected), bIsLeader initialized 0
functions.notes: Member accessors: FUN_112e9990=name-key, FUN_112e9970=level, FUN_112e99d0=weapon, FUN_112e9950=class, FUN_112e99b0=starLevel source. teammemberInfoArr pushed via VO vtbl+5 (append-array).

functions.purpose: Builds arrTaskData for the NewOperationActivity detail view. Resolves local player, iterates the activity's task table and for each task whose byte at [record-0x22]==0x20 (' ', 'active/shown' flag) emits an ActivityDetailData VO (class 'mh.view.NewOperationActivity.Data.ActivityDetailData') with EntryId, taskState (0/1 completion), taskDesc. taskState is computed from server-tracked progress.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only VO build, but taskState is DERIVED from server-authoritative progress: server owns the completion counters queried by FUN_11513b40. Useful to mirror the completion gate.
formulas: record base = activityObj+0xaf6, stride 0x423 bytes, loop while index < taskCount
taskState = 1 IFF ( *(player+0x2acc)!=0  AND  FUN_11513b40(*ESI, *(byte*)(ESI+5), taskTypeArg, &progressOut)!='\0'  AND  progressOut!=0 ); else taskState = 0
taskDesc built from CPet::SetName(record-0x20) name buffer
functions.notes: *(player+0x2acc) = player activity-state block (confirmed by economy.md). FUN_11513b40 is the activity-task completion/progress query. Record layout: [-0x23]=EntryId, [-0x22]=shown flag, [-0x20]=name/desc buffer, [0]=task type.

functions.purpose: Builds guildTaskInfoData VO for a single guild task/commission (in_stack_00000014==2 guard). Resolves taskId from request variant, looks up guild + task-config + reward record, and emits strName, taskId, nMoneyType, nMoneyCount, nTaskAddition, strTarget, the six button-gate booleans (bShowAccept/bEnableAccept/bShowGiveUp/bEnableGiveUp/bShowFinish/bEnableFinish), and nTaskState. Handles the special generic task id 99999.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only VO build for the guild-task panel, but reward amounts (nMoneyCount/nMoneyType), nTaskAddition, hunt-count progress and nTaskState are server-authoritative; the accept/giveup/finish gates and reward math are worth mirroring server-side for validation.
formulas: reward record = FUN_10804940(iStack_a0+0x4c, 0x18)  // lookup by 0x18-stride table
if taskId==99999: strName/taskId overridden with generic guild-task record (FUN_109df950)
target list: iterate task targets at stride 0xec=236 bytes; strTarget from *(entry+0x18)(DAT_11de486c) and *(entry+0x1c)(DAT_11de4830)
button gates default 0 then set via (*(*apiStack_90[0]+0x30))(0x494, 2, &stateVar)  // 0x494=1172 task-state query
costs: nMoneyType / nMoneyCount: guild-task reward currency type and amount (server-authoritative)
functions.notes: Field strings: GUILD_TASK_INFO_DATA_NAME(class), strName, taskId, nMoneyType, nMoneyCount, nTaskAddition, strTarget, nTaskState, guildTaskInfoData. taskId 99999 = the fixed/daily generic guild task. Many unreachable-block warnings; reward-branch offsets (reward+8, +0xc) reliable, exact currency-type resolution partly obscured.

functions.purpose: Lazily initializes and returns the network-message (RMI) field descriptor for a task-state notification. Fields: Enable(bool), playerNetID, taskID, taskState. One-time init guarded by DAT_12035390 bits 0/1; assigns the descriptor to *param_1 and the taskState sub-field table to param_1[1].
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative wire schema: this defines the on-the-wire layout of a server->client task-state message (playerNetID, taskID, taskState). Directly mirror for the private server's task-update packet.
formulas: field set = { Enable:bool, playerNetID:int, taskID:int, taskState:int }
functions.notes: Message field builders PTR_FUN_11df7674/766c (int fields), 11df7734/772c (bool). Compare with FUN_10e3f1f0 (adds 'result').

functions.purpose: Lazily initializes and returns the network-message descriptor for a task RESULT notification. Fields: Enable(bool), playerNetID, taskID, taskState, plus a trailing result field. One-time init guarded by DAT_12035430 bits 0/1.

formulas: field set = { Enable:bool, playerNetID:int, taskID:int, taskState:int, result:int }
functions.notes: Sibling of FUN_10e3efd0 with an extra 'result' field.
